time_convention: t = frame / 30; frame 0 = t 0; last frame 93 = t 3.100 s
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed
summary: Static outdoor basketball court (green/grey surface, white lines), seen from the near court. One person standing on an electric kick-scooter rides from right to left along the far baseline of the court for the whole clip at nearly constant speed (~16 px/frame). Background: grass field, soccer goals, Adirondack chair, two basketball hoops, Mediterranean-style buildings, trees. Handheld camera with slow drift (<= 13 px over the clip).

camera.type: handheld, nearly static; slow smooth drift, no pan following the rider
camera.per_frame_shift_file: scene/camera_shift.json (dx, dy of background content relative to frame 0, px; image point of a fixed ground feature at frame i = frame-0 position + (dx, dy))
camera.note: Drift is small vs the rider's ~1460 px travel (0.9 %), but rider.csv gives both raw image coords (*_img) and background-stabilised coords (*_stab, frame-0 background frame). Use *_stab for motion against the ground.

objects.name: scooter_rider
objects.description: Person (white long-sleeve top, beige/white cap, dark olive trousers, black belt, light shoes; face blurred) standing on a black electric kick-scooter (two small black wheels, rear wheel with spokes/fender, tall stem with handlebar). The only moving object.
objects.motion: straight horizontal motion right->left (decreasing x) along the far baseline, ground-contact line y ~1177 (stab coords), no vertical motion; image x from bbox centre 2711.5 (f0) to 1235 (f93) stabilised
objects.reference_point: cx_stab/cy_stab = bbox centre of mask (person+scooter, shadow excluded); alternatives: centroid_x_stab, front_wheel_x_stab (leading edge of front wheel)

pixel_sizes_median_over_clip.scooter_length_note: front edge of front wheel to back of rear wheel/fender, horizontal (= main motion axis); 182 px in frames 0-3 (slight motion blur/stem), 176-178 px afterwards
pixel_sizes_median_over_clip.height_note: top of cap to wheel ground contact; range 296-303
pixel_sizes_median_over_clip.person_height_note: approx: soles stand on the deck ~23-25 px above ground contact (deck at about wheel-centre height). Person stands with knees slightly bent; +-5 px
pixel_sizes_median_over_clip.wheel_note: Hough circles at frames 0,15,...,93: radius 18.3-20 px (mostly 18.6), axle spacing 136.7-142.5 px (median ~139)

objects.apparent_size_change: none significant (bbox width 176-183, height 296-303 px); motion is parallel to the image plane at constant depth

objects.name: rider_shadow
objects.description: Long dark shadow of rider+scooter cast on the court to the right and slightly below the wheels; moves with rider. Excluded from rider mask.

objects.name: left_basketball_hoop
objects.description: Left hoop: transparent rectangular backboard with orange rim, black pole; bird perched on top of backboard

frame0_px.pole_shadow: dark shadow on court right of pole base, x ~600-1110, y ~1195-1240

objects.name: right_basketball_hoop
objects.description: Right hoop at right image edge, same type; pole bent/angled (goes up and to the right)

objects.name: bird
objects.description: Small dark bird (magpie/crow-like, black and white) perched on top edge of the left backboard

objects.name: soccer_goal_near
objects.description: White net soccer goal on the grass behind the left half of the court, angled

objects.name: small_goal_far

objects.name: adirondack_chair
objects.description: Dark wooden Adirondack chair on the grass, far left

objects.name: court_lane_lines
objects.description: Two white lines of the key/lane running from the image bottom toward the far baseline, converging with perspective; they end at the far baseline line (faint white, y ~1158) just behind the rider's path

frame0_px.near_crossing_lines_y: horizontal white lines at y ~1750 (left, x 0-1210) and ~1780 (right, x 2580-3840)

objects.name: far_baseline_and_arcs
objects.description: Far baseline (faint white line along the court/grass edge, y ~1158-1165) and 3-point arc lines on both sides of the far court

objects.name: background
objects.description: Grass field (y ~1000-1150), hedge/fence, pergola (right of centre, x ~2500-3300, y ~870-1000), tan multi-storey buildings with tiled roofs, trees, blue sky

events.event: rider passes right lane line top (x~2193)
rider passes left lane line top (x~1827)
rider still moving at end, no stop, no direction change

motion_overview_px_per_frame: bbox-centre step (stab) -17 at start, ~-15.5 mid-clip (frames 30-55), ~-16 at end; 10-frame steps: -165.5,-160.5,-157.5,-156,-154.5,-156.5,-159.5,-158.5,-159.5 (frames 0-90). Recorded only as a sanity check; no model fitted.
perspective: 2D-style: rider moves parallel to the image plane at constant depth (ground contact y constant +-2 px, size constant). Court plane recedes toward a horizon above the image region of the court (lane lines converge upward); hoops at the far baseline are at about the rider's depth (pole bases y 1150-1163 vs rider ground y ~1177, i.e. rider is slightly nearer than the baseline).
